name: nova-ai
description: Nova AI — a premium unified AI workspace (chat, search, image, voice, video, music, tools).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/web && npm run lint --workspace apps/api
